title: BBQ Easy
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Snuke is having a barbeque party.

At the party, he will make $N$ servings of *Skewer Meal*.

![image](https://agc001.contest.atcoder.jp/img/agc/001/Gg9pvPKw/abbq.png) Example of a serving of Skewer Meal

He has a stock of $2N$ skewers, all of which will be used in Skewer Meal. The length of the $i$-th skewer is $L_i$. Also, he has an infinite supply of ingredients.

To make a serving of Skewer Meal, he picks $2$ skewers and threads ingredients onto those skewers. Let the length of the shorter skewer be $x$, then the serving can hold the maximum of $x$ ingredients.

What is the maximum total number of ingredients that his $N$ servings of Skewer Meal can hold, if he uses the skewers optimally?

## Constraints

- $1≦N≦100$
- $1≦L_i≦100$
- For each $i$, $L_i$ is an integer.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
L_1 L_2 ... L_{2N}
```

## Output

Print the maximum total number of ingredients that Snuke's $N$ servings of Skewer Meal can hold.

## 题目描述

Snuke 正在举办一场烧烤聚会。

在聚会上，他将制作 $N$ 份*烤串餐*。

![烤串餐示例](https://agc001.contest.atcoder.jp/img/agc/001/Gg9pvPKw/abbq.png)

他有 $2N$ 根竹签，全部都将用于制作烤串餐。第 $i$ 根竹签的长度为 $L_i$。此外，他还有无限量的食材。

制作一份烤串餐时，他会选取 $2$ 根竹签，并将食材串在这两根竹签上。设较短竹签的长度为 $x$，则这份烤串餐最多可以容纳 $x$ 份食材。

如果合理地使用竹签，他制作的 $N$ 份烤串餐总共最多可以容纳多少份食材？

## 约束条件

- $1≦N≦100$
- $1≦L_i≦100$
- 对于每个 $i$，$L_i$ 都是整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N
L_1 L_2 ... L_{2N}
```

## 输出格式

输出 Snuke 制作的 $N$ 份烤串餐总共最多可以容纳的食材份数。

samples.note: If he makes a serving using the first and third skewers, and another using the second and fourth skewers, each serving will hold $1$ and $2$ ingredients, for the total of $3$.
